questions.q: Fermat's Last Theorem says x^n + y^n = z^n has no positive solutions for n > 2. For n = 3 compute 5^3 - (3^3 + 4^3) to see it is not zero.
Check whether 6 is a perfect number: its proper divisors are 1, 2 and 3. Find their sum.
The numbers 11 and 13 are consecutive primes. How far apart are they (twin primes differ by 2)?
Are 8 and 15 co-prime? Their common factors are only 1, so their HCF is what?
Divisibility by 9: a number is divisible by 9 when its digit sum is. Find the digit sum of 729 and report the digit sum.
Divisibility by 11: add and subtract alternate digits of 2728 from the right (8 - 2 + 7 - 2) and report the result.
A price index uses base year value 100. If the current value is 155, find the index number.
For 3 commodities the current-year prices are 18, 20, 10 and the base-year prices are 5, 14, 10. Find the simple aggregative price index (two decimal places).
A Laspeyres price index is 165.52 and the corresponding Paasche price index is 165.52. Find the time reversal factor L x P / 10000 (two decimal places).
A linear trend line is y = 67 + 3 x. Find the fitted value at x = 5.
Two mixtures cost Rs 5 per kg (3 kg) and Rs 8 per kg (7 kg). Find the mean price by alligation (two decimal places).
A vessel holds 60 litres; 10 litres are drawn and replaced with water, once. How much of the original liquid remains?
A canteen offers 9 drinks and 6 snacks. How many drink-snack combos are possible (rule of product)?
How many ordered pairs are in the Cartesian product of a set of size 8 with a set of size 7?
How many subsets does a set with 8 elements have?
A set A has 4 elements. A relation from A to A is any subset of A x A; how many such relations exist?
Find the number of arrangements (permutations) of 6 distinct objects taken 1 at a time.
How many distinct arrangements does the word with 2 identical 'a's and 2 identical 'b's have? (total 4 letters)
